name: Deep Purple

whyMatters.en: Mark II lineup (Blackmore / Gillan / Glover / Lord / Paice) set hard rock with Hammond organ equal to guitar: Machine Head (1972) and the live album Made in Japan.
whyMatters.zh: Mark II 阵容（Blackmore / Gillan / Glover / Lord / Paice）确立 Hammond 管风琴与吉他对等的 hard rock：《Machine Head》（1972）与现场专辑《Made in Japan》。

note.en: Open-fifth riff from Machine Head; lyric about the Montreux casino fire.
note.zh: 出自《Machine Head》的开放五度 riff；歌词写蒙特勒赌场火灾。

note.en: Speed riff; Blackmore classical figures and Lord Hammond trade lines.
note.zh: 速度 riff；Blackmore 古典音型与 Lord Hammond 交替。

note.en: From Deep Purple in Rock; Gillan scream over Lord’s organ bed.
note.zh: 出自《Deep Purple in Rock》；Gillan 尖叫压在 Lord 管风琴铺底上。

interviewQuotes.text: I don't like to be predictable.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ritchie Blackmore

interviewQuotes.text: The organ was as loud as the guitar.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jon Lord
interviewQuotes.source: On early Purple live mix · press

lyricQuotes: We all came out to Montreux / On the Lake Geneva shoreline
Nobody's gonna take my car, I'm gonna race it to the ground

shortBio.en: Mark II hard rock; Smoke on the Water made the open-fifth riff a worldwide beginner standard.
shortBio.zh: Mark II hard rock；《Smoke on the Water》的开放五度 riff 成为全球入门标准之一。

body.en:
Deep Purple formed in 1968. The commercially decisive era is 1970–73 Mark II. Deep Purple in Rock and Machine Head combine Jon Lord’s Hammond with Blackmore’s blues and classical guitar figures.

Smoke on the Water (1972) is one of the most widely learned guitar riffs; Highway Star and Lazy show speed and jazz-blues stretch. Blackmore left in 1975 to form Rainbow. They sit with Sabbath and Zeppelin as early-1970s hard-rock pillars, with more organ in the mix than either.
body.zh:
Deep Purple 于 1968 年成立。商业与风格决定期是 1970–73 的 Mark II。《Deep Purple in Rock》与《Machine Head》把 Jon Lord 的 Hammond 与 Blackmore 的蓝调—古典吉他音型结合。

《Smoke on the Water》（1972）是全球最常学的吉他 riff 之一；《Highway Star》《Lazy》展示速度与爵士蓝调延伸。Blackmore 1975 离队组建 Rainbow。与 Sabbath、Zeppelin 同属 70 年代初 hard-rock 支柱，管风琴在混音中的比重更高。

title.zh: 管风琴与 riff 并列

body.en:
Mark II sets hard rock with Lord’s Hammond equal to Blackmore’s guitar in the live mix.

Machine Head (1972) and Made in Japan are the main studio and live documents.

More organ-forward than Zeppelin or Sabbath.
body.zh:
Mark II 确立 hard rock 中 Lord 的 Hammond 与 Blackmore 吉他在现场混音中对等。

《Machine Head》（1972）与《Made in Japan》是主要录音室与现场文献。

管风琴比重高于 Zeppelin 或 Sabbath。

title.en: Mark I / II / III and Blackmore exit
title.zh: Mark I / II / III 与 Blackmore 离队

body.en:
Mark I: Evans/Simper era. Mark II: Gillan/Glover peak. Mark III: Coverdale/Hughes after Gillan and Glover leave.

Blackmore exits in 1975 to form Rainbow. Ian Paice remains the continuous drum seat across marks.
body.zh:
Mark I：Evans/Simper 时期。Mark II：Gillan/Glover 峰值。Mark III：Gillan/Glover 离队后 Coverdale/Hughes。

Blackmore 1975 离队组建 Rainbow。Ian Paice 是各 Mark 中连续的鼓席。

body.en:
Open-fifth figure over Lord’s organ and Paice’s pocket. The lyric documents the Montreux casino fire.

It became one of the first riffs many guitarists learn worldwide.

Highway Star on the same album shows the speed and neoclassical lead side.
body.zh:
开放五度音型压在 Lord 管风琴与 Paice 律动上。歌词记录蒙特勒赌场火灾。

成为全球许多吉他手最早学会的 riff 之一。

同一专辑的《Highway Star》展示速度与新古典主音面。

body.en:
Blackmore blends blues bends with classical scalar runs. Lord treats Hammond as a lead instrument. Gillan’s scream sits above without heavy melisma.

Glover and Paice hold the pocket that Made in Japan documents.
body.zh:
Blackmore 把蓝调弯音与古典音阶跑动混合。Lord 把 Hammond 当主奏乐器。Gillan 尖叫坐在上方，少用花腔。

Glover 与 Paice 维持《Made in Japan》记录的律动。

title.zh: 不可预测的离队，响管风琴

body.en:
Blackmore’s line about not liking to be predictable foreshadows the Rainbow split.

Lord’s equal-volume organ claim is the mix fact behind the Mark II sound.

Quotes document method more than myth.
body.zh:
Blackmore「不喜欢可预测」一句预示后来与 Rainbow 的分裂。

Lord「管风琴与吉他一样响」是 Mark II 声音背后的混音事实。

引语更多记录方法，而非神话。

body.en:
Iron Maiden and later metal acts cite the riff-plus-organ weight and Gillan-range vocals.

Rainbow continues Blackmore’s neoclassical lead path with Dio.

Smoke on the Water remains a common first riff for guitar students.
body.zh:
Iron Maiden 与后来金属引用「riff + 管风琴」的重量与 Gillan 音域人声。

Rainbow 以 Dio 延续 Blackmore 的新古典主音路径。

《Smoke on the Water》仍是吉他入门常学的 riff。

note.en: Early albums before Gillan/Glover; psychedelic/hard-rock mix.
note.zh: Gillan/Glover 前的早期专辑；迷幻与 hard-rock 混合。

note.en: In Rock / Machine Head / Made in Japan era.
Burn / Stormbringer; Blackmore exits 1975 to Rainbow.
Open-fifth riff; among the most widely learned guitar figures.
note.zh: 开放五度 riff；全球最常学的吉他音型之一。

note.en: Hammond equal to guitar in the hard-rock mix.
note.zh: Hard-rock 混音中 Hammond 与吉他对等。
